title: Venice, 5 July 1536: the siege of Marseille (f. 43v)
caption: The first three cipher lines on f. 43v of Georges de Selve's letter to Francis I (BnF fr. 3045, via Gallica): “[la ville fut] en tres grand danger, combien que le nombre des assiegeans fust sans comparaison moindre que celuy qu'il ...”
key_note: Simple substitution with invented signs (S. Tomokiyo's table, extended here): three signs for e, two or three for a; the same hook serves c and d, decided by the French; S is a null. Word division is editorial.
